paragraphs: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (the "Company", "we," "us," or "our") is a diversified, global biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes a diverse portfolio of essential medicines. Our Affordable Medicines segment includes retail generics, injectables, and biosimilars. In our Specialty segment, we offer a portfolio of branded pharmaceuticals focused primarily on central nervous system and endocrine disorders. Through our AvKARE segment, we are a distributor of pharmaceuticals and other products for the U.S. federal government, retail, and institutional markets. We operate principally in the United States ("U.S."), India, and Ireland. Refer to the section "Segments of the Business" below for an overview of our segments.

We are a holding company, whose principal assets are common units (the "Amneal Common Units") of Amneal Pharmaceuticals, LLC ("Amneal"). Immediately prior to the Reorganization (as defined herein), we held 50.4% of the Amneal Common Units and the group, together with their affiliates and certain assignees, who owned Amneal when it was a private company (the "Members" or the "Amneal Group") held the remaining 49.6%. On November 7, 2023, we implemented a plan pursuant to which the Company and Amneal reorganized and simplified our corporate structure by eliminating our umbrella partnership-C-corporation structure and converting to a more traditional C-corporation structure whereby all stockholders hold their voting and economic interests directly through the public company (the "Reorganization"). Effective with the Reorganization, we hold 100% of the Amneal Common Units and continue to consolidate the financial statements of Amneal and its subsidiaries. Refer to Note 1. Nature of Operations for additional information about the Reorganization.

Although we had a minority economic interest in Amneal prior to March 2023, we were Amneal's sole managing member (and we continue to be the sole managing member), having the sole voting power to make all of Amneal's business decisions and control its management. Therefore, we consolidated the financial statements of Amneal and its subsidiaries for all periods prior to the Reorganization. We recorded non-controlling interests for the portion of Amneal's economic interests that we did not hold prior to the Reorganization.

On May 8, 2025, we entered into a 15-year strategic collaboration agreement with ApiJect Systems, Corp. and related entities ("ApiJect"), a medical technology company focused on advanced drug delivery ("ApiJect Agreement"). Under the ApiJect Agreement, we will install and operate manufacturing equipment leased from Apiject at our Brookhaven, New York facility. This equipment will be used to support production of ApiJect's proprietary blow fill seal ("BFS") delivery systems and our growing injectable portfolio. We will pay a low-digit royalty to ApiJect for any of our commercial products that are manufactured utilizing the equipment. At the conclusion of the term of the ApiJect Agreement, we have the right to purchase the equipment from ApiJect for a nominal amount. We will also collaborate with ApiJect on the development of additional injectable product programs utilizing ApiJect's BFS platform. We are entitled to receive consideration from ApiJect for development work performed under these programs.

On September 30, 2024, the Company entered into a collaboration agreement with Metsera, Inc. ("Metsera"), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, under which the Company became Metsera's preferred global supply partner for its portfolio of weight loss medicines. The agreement also grants the Company an exclusive license to commercialize certain Metsera products in select emerging markets, including India, certain Southeast Asian countries, Africa, and the Middle East.

Under the terms of the agreement, the Company is responsible for specified manufacturing and development activities. Following regulatory approval of any of the medicines covered by the agreement, the Company will supply commercial products to Metsera in exchange for compensation at cost plus a margin, and tiered low single-digit percentages of Metsera's gross profit.

The Company is constructing two manufacturing facilities in India, one for active pharmaceutical ingredient ("API") production and one for fill-finish manufacturing. Metsera will fund an agreed-upon percentage of these construction costs, up to $100 million, subject to annual caps. In consideration of Metsera's funding, the Company initially agreed to (i) provide a rebate on each unit of commercial injectable product produced by the Company and purchased by Metsera, and (ii) make a payment to Metsera for each unit of commercial product manufactured for the Company or third parties using the facilities, in aggregate up to the amount of Metsera's construction funding.

On November 13, 2025, Metsera was acquired by Pfizer Inc. On January 30, 2026, Pfizer exercised its rights under the agreement's change-in-control provision to shorten the agreement's term from seven years to four years from the date of first commercial sale. As a result, the Company's rebate and construction cost reimbursement obligations described above have been eliminated. Metsera's cost sharing commitment of up to $100 million and all other terms of the agreement remain unchanged.

On February 23, 2024, we entered into a license, distribution and supply agreement with Zambon Biotech S.A. ("Zambon") granting Zambon the exclusive rights to seek regulatory approval and commercialize IPX203 in Europe (the "Zambon License Agreement"). The term for the Zambon License Agreement is 15 years commencing from the commercial launch of the product, which can automatically renew for successive two-year periods unless either party provides notice declining such renewal at least one year in advance. Zambon will be responsible for the performance of all R&D activities, regulatory approval, commercialization, and marketing activities for the territories in the agreement to be conducted to obtain regulatory approval for each product. Upon achieving regulatory approval for products, we will be responsible for manufacturing and supplying products to Zambon.

As of December 31, 2025, IPX203 had not been approved for sale outside of the United States, where it is marketed as CREXONT®. CREXONT® (combination of carbidopa and levodopa extended release capsules) is indicated in the United States for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

On January 24, 2024, we entered into a 15-year license, distribution and supply agreement with Knight Therapeutics International S.A. ("Knight") granting Knight the exclusive rights to seek regulatory approval and commercialize IPX203 in Canada and Latin America (the "Knight License Agreement"). The Knight License Agreement will automatically renew for successive two-year periods unless either party provides notice declining such renewal at least one year in advance.

Knight will be responsible for the performance of all R&D activities, regulatory approval, commercialization, and marketing activities for the territories in the agreement to be conducted to obtain regulatory approval for each product. Upon achieving regulatory approval for products, Amneal will be responsible for manufacturing and supplying products to Knight.
As of December 31, 2025, IPX203 had not been approved for sale outside of the United States, where it is marketed as CREXONT®.

On December 5, 2023, we entered into a license agreement with BIAL-Portela & Ca., S.A. ("BIAL") for the exclusive rights to market and distribute ONGENTYS® (opicapone) in the U.S. starting on December 18, 2023 and ending at such time when generic opicapone sales reach certain predetermined thresholds (the "BIAL Agreement"). ONGENTYS® is BIAL's proprietary, once-daily, peripherally-acting, highly-selective catechol-O-methyltransferase inhibitor approved by the FDA in 2020 as an add-on treatment to carbidopa/levodopa in patients with Parkinson's disease experiencing "off" episodes. Under the BIAL Agreement, we are responsible for commercialization and marketing of ONGENTYS® in the U.S. and BIAL is responsible for manufacturing and supply. We commenced distribution of ONGENTYS® in early 2024. In December 2025, we exercised our contractual right and notified BIAL of our intent to terminate the license agreement effective February 26, 2028, unless both sides agree to an extension. Until the termination becomes effective, we continue to operate under the terms of the license agreement.

headings: If we cannot successfully develop or commercialize new products, our operating results will suffer.

We face intense competition in the pharmaceutical industry from both brand and generic drug product companies, which could significantly limit our growth and materially adversely affect our financial results.
If we fail to obtain exclusive marketing rights for our products or fail to introduce our products to the market timely, our revenues, gross margin and operating results may decline significantly.
As our competitors introduce their own generic equivalents of our generic drug products, our revenues and gross margin from such products generally decline, often rapidly.
Our business is highly dependent on market perceptions of us and the safety and quality of our products.
A substantial portion of our total revenues is expected to be derived from sales of a limited number of products.
Our approved products may not achieve expected levels of market acceptance.
We may discontinue the manufacture and distribution of certain existing products, which may adversely impact our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Manufacturing or quality control problems may damage our reputation for quality production, demand costly remedial activities and negatively impact our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Our profitability depends on our major customers. If these relationships do not continue as expected, our business, condition (financial and otherwise), prospects and results of operations could materially suffer.
Customer consolidation could cause declines in sales volume and the prices of our products, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial position and results of operations.
Supply chain disruptions could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial position and results of operations.
Changes in trade policy, including the imposition of tariffs may affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
A U.S. government shutdown could adversely impact our regulatory, operational and financial performance.
The time necessary to develop generic drugs may adversely affect whether, and the extent to which, we receive a return on our capital.

If we are unable to execute acquisitions or other strategic transactions, or successfully integrate such acquisitions or manage our growth therefrom, it could have a material adverse effect on our business.
We depend on information technology, and our systems and infrastructure face certain risks, including cybersecurity and data leakage risks.
Failure to successfully implement a new enterprise resource planning system could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Artificial intelligence-based platforms may present new risks and challenges to our business.
Catastrophic events, including severe weather events, war and terrorist attacks, may negatively affect our business and results of operations.
paragraphs: An investment in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. In deciding whether to invest in our common stock, you should consider carefully the following risk factors, as well as the other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The materialization of any of these risks could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

(the "Company", "we," "us," or "our") is a diversified, global biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes a diverse portfolio of essential medicines. Our Affordable Medicines segment includes retail generics, injectables, and biosimilars. In our Specialty segment, we offer a portfolio of branded pharmaceuticals focused primarily on central nervous system and endocrine disorders. Through our AvKARE segment, we are a distributor of pharmaceuticals and other products for the U.S. federal government, retail, and institutional markets. We operate principally in the U.S., India, and Ireland. Refer to the section "Segments" below for an overview of our segments.

Prior to the Reorganization (as defined herein), we were a holding company, whose principal assets were common units (the "Amneal Common Units") of Amneal Pharmaceuticals, LLC ("Amneal"). As of September 30, 2023, we held 50.4% of the Amneal Common Units and the group, together with their affiliates and certain assignees, who owned Amneal when it was a private company (the "Amneal Group") held the remaining 49.6%. The following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of certain factors, including those set forth under Item 1A. Risk Factors and under the heading Forward-Looking Statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following discussion and analysis, as well as other sections in this report, should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes to consolidated financial statements included elsewhere herein.

For a discussion of our financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, see "Results of Operations" and "Liquidity and Capital Resources" under Part II, Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations in our 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K, filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on February 28, 2025.
We have three reportable segments: Affordable Medicines, Specialty, and AvKARE.

Our Affordable Medicines segment includes over 280 product families covering an extensive range of dosage forms and delivery systems, including both immediate and extended-release oral solids, powders, liquids, sterile injectables, nasal sprays, inhalation and respiratory products, biosimilar products, ophthalmics, films, transdermal patches and topicals. We focus on developing products that have substantial barriers-to-entry due to complex drug formulations or manufacturing, or legal or regulatory challenges.

Generic products, particularly in the U.S., generally contribute most significantly to revenues and gross margins at the time of their launch, and even more so in periods of market exclusivity, or in periods of limited generic competition. As such, the timing of new product introductions can have a significant impact on our financial results. The entrance into the market of additional competition generally has a negative impact on the volume and/or pricing of the affected products. Additionally, pricing is determined by market place dynamics and is often affected by factors outside of our control.

Our Specialty segment is engaged in the development, promotion, sale and distribution of proprietary branded pharmaceutical products, with a focus on products addressing central nervous system disorders, including Parkinson's disease, and endocrine disorders. Significant products within our Specialty segment include CREXONT® (combination of carbidopa and levodopa extended release capsules), RYTARY® (extended release oral capsule formulation of carbidopa-levodopa), UNITHROID® (levothyroxine sodium), and Brekiya® (dihydroergotamine mesylate) injection. In September 2024, we began selling CREXONT®, which is indicated for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, Parkinson's disease caused by infection or inflammation of the brain, or Parkinson's disease-like symptoms that may result from carbon monoxide or manganese

poisoning in adults. RYTARY® is indicated for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, post-encephalitic parkinsonism, and parkinsonism that may follow carbon monoxide intoxication or manganese intoxication. UNITHROID®, indicated for the treatment of hypothyroidism, is sold under a license and distribution agreement with Jerome Stevens Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

New product launches are an important growth driver. Brekiya® autoinjector, approved by the FDA in May 2025 and launched in the U.S. in October 2025, is the first and only ready-to-use autoinjector formulation of dihydroergotamine mesylate indicated for the acute treatment of migraine, with or without aura, and for the acute treatment of cluster headache in adults.

Our Specialty products are marketed through skilled specialty sales and marketing teams, who call on neurologists, movement disorder specialists, endocrinologists and primary care physicians throughout the U.S. Our Specialty segment also has other product candidates that are in varying stages of development.

For Specialty products, the majority of such products' commercial value is usually realized during the period in which the product has market exclusivity. In the U.S., when market exclusivity expires and generic versions of a product are approved and marketed, there can often be substantial and rapid declines in the branded product's sales. In 2025, an authorized generic version of RYTARY® was launched, and the Company anticipates multiple generic versions of RYTARY® to be introduced in the future.

In 2025, CREXONT® continued to grow within our Specialty segment. CREXONT® was added to three large national formularies, which expanded total U.S. insurance coverage from about 30% of covered lives at the end of 2024 to over 50% at the end of 2025. In December 2025, we announced new positive interim results from our ongoing Phase 4 ELEVATE-PD study, including significant increases in daily "Good On" time and reductions in "Off" time.

Our AvKARE segment provides pharmaceuticals primarily to governmental agencies, predominantly focused on serving the U.S. Department of Defense and the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. AvKARE is also a re-packager of bottle and unit dose pharmaceuticals and vitamins under the registered names of AvKARE and AvPAK. AvKARE is also a wholesale distributor of pharmaceuticals, over the counter drugs and medical supplies to its retail and institutional customers that are located throughout the U.S. focused primarily on entities that provide care to low-income and uninsured patients. Operating results for the sale of Amneal products by AvKARE are included in our Affordable Medicines reportable segment.

paragraphs: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (the "Company", "we," "us," or "our") 為一間多元化、全球性的生技藥品公司，從事開發、製造、行銷與分銷多樣化的必要藥物。我們的 Affordable Medicines 分部包括零售用一般藥品、注射劑與生物相似藥。在 Specialty 分部中，我們提供專注於中樞神經系統與內分泌系統疾病的標的藥品組合。透過 AvKARE 分部，我們為美國聯邦政府、零售與機構市場分銷藥品及其他產品。我們主要營運於美國 ("U.S."), 印度與愛爾蘭。請參閱下方 "業務分部" 節以瞭解我們的分部概要。

我們為一間控股公司，主要資產為 Amneal Pharmaceuticals, LLC ("Amneal") 的普通單位 (the "Amneal Common Units")。在重組 (as defined herein) 之前，我們持有 50.4% 的 Amneal Common Units，而集團與其關係企業及特定讓與人，這些人在 Amneal 為私人公司時擁有 Amneal (the "Members" or the "Amneal Group") 持有剩餘的 49.6%。2023 年 11 月 7 日，我們執行了一項計畫，根據該計畫，本公司與 Amneal 重組並簡化我們的公司結構，消除我們的傘型合夥企業-C 股權公司結構，轉為更傳統的 C 股權公司結構，使所有股東直接透過上市公司持有其投票與經濟權益 (the "Reorganization")。重組生效後，我們持有 100% 的 Amneal Common Units，並繼續合併 Amneal 及其子公司財務報表。請參閱附註 1. 業務性質以取得更多關於重組的資訊。
儘管我們在 2023 年 3 月之前對 Amneal 有少數經濟權益，我們仍是 Amneal 的唯一管理成員 (且我們繼續為唯一管理成員)，擁有獨佔投票權以做出 Amneal 的所有商業決策並控制其管理。因此，我們在重組前的所有期間均合併 Amneal 及其子公司財務報表。我們為我們未持有之 Amneal 經濟權益部分記錄非控制性權益。

2025 年 5 月 8 日，我們與 ApiJect Systems, Corp. 及相關實體 ("ApiJect") 籤訂了一項 15 年戰略合作協議 ("ApiJect Agreement")，ApiJect 為一間專注於先進藥物遞送技術的醫療科技公司。根據 ApiJect 協議，我們將在紐約布魯克黑文廠區安裝並運作從 ApiJect 租賃的製造設備。此設備將用於支援 ApiJect 的專利吹填封 ("BFS") 遞送系統及我們日益增長的注射劑產品組合。我們將為任何使用此設備製造的商業產品向 ApiJect 支付低位數 royalty。在 ApiJect 協議期限屆滿時，我們有權以微小金額購入此設備。我們將與 ApiJect 合作開發更多注射劑產品計畫，使用 ApiJect 的 BFS 平台。我們有權獲得 ApiJect 對這些計畫所進行開發工作的報酬。
2024 年 9 月 30 日，本公司與 Metsera, Inc. ("Metsera") 籤訂了一項合作協議，Metsera 為一間臨牀階段的生技藥品公司。根據協議，本公司成為 Metsera 重量減輕藥物組合的首選全球供應夥伴。協議也授予本公司獨家許可，在特定新興市場，包括印度、某些東南亞國家、非洲與中東，商業化 Metsera 的部分產品。
根據協議條款，本公司負責指定的製造與開發活動。在協議涵蓋的任何藥物獲得監管批准後，本公司將為 Metsera 提供商業產品，換取成本加邊際利潤，以及 Metsera 毛利率的 tiered 低位數百分比報酬。

本公司正在印度建設兩座製造廠，一座用於活性藥物成分 ("API") 生產，一座用於灌裝完成製造。Metsera 將為這些建設成本提供協議約定的百分比資金，最高達 100 百萬美元，並受年度上限限制。作為對 Metsera 資金的考慮，本公司最初同意 (i) 對於本公司生產並由 Metsera 購買的每單位商業注射劑產品提供回扣，以及 (ii) 對於本公司或第三方使用這些廠房製造的每單位商業產品向 Metsera 支付費用，總計不超過 Metsera 的建設資金金額。
2025 年 11 月 13 日，Metsera 被 Pfizer Inc. 收購。2026 年 1 月 30 日，Pfizer 行使其根據協議變更控制權條款的權利，將協議的期限從首次商業銷售日後七年縮短為四年。因此，本公司上述的回扣與建設成本補償義務已消除。Metsera 的資金共享承諾最高達 100 百萬美元，以及協議的其他條款保持不變。

於 2024 年 2 月 23 日，本公司與 Zambon Biotech S.A.（"Zambon"）簽訂授權、分銷與供應協議，授予 Zambon 專屬權利，以尋求在歐洲取得監管批准並商業化 IPX203（"Zambon 授權協議"）。Zambon 授權協議的期限為 15 年，自產品商業發行日起計算，可自動延長為連續的兩年期，除非任一方至少提前一年通知不續約。Zambon 將負責執行所有研發活動、監管批准、商業化及市場推廣活動，以在協議所指的地區進行取得每項產品監管批准的相關作業。在取得產品監管批准後，本公司將負責製造並供應產品給 Zambon。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，IPX203 仍未獲得美國以外地區的銷售批准，其在美國以 CREXONT® 品牌銷售。CREXONT®（carbidopa 與 levodopa 延長釋放膠囊組合）在美國用於治療帕金森氏症。
於 2024 年 1 月 24 日，本公司與 Knight Therapeutics International S.A.（"Knight"）簽訂 15 年授權、分銷與供應協議，授予 Knight 專屬權利，以尋求在加拿大及拉丁美洲取得監管批准並商業化 IPX203（"Knight 授權協議"）。Knight 授權協議將自動延長為連續的兩年期，除非任一方至少提前一年通知不續約。
Knight 將負責執行所有研發活動、監管批准、商業化及市場推廣活動，以在協議所指的地區進行取得每項產品監管批准的相關作業。在取得產品監管批准後，Amneal 將負責製造並供應產品給 Knight。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，IPX203 仍未獲得美國以外地區的銷售批准，其在美國以 CREXONT® 品牌銷售。

於 2023 年 12 月 5 日，本公司與 BIAL-Portela & Ca., S.A.（"BIAL"）簽訂授權協議，取得專屬權利，自 2023 年 12 月 18 日起，在美國市場行銷與分銷 ONGENTYS®（opicapone），並於 generic opicapone 銷售達到預定門檻時終止（"BIAL 協議"）。ONGENTYS® 是 BIAL 的智慧財產權，為每日一次、外用、高度選擇性 catechol-O-methyltransferase 抑制劑，於 2020 年經 FDA 批准，作為 carbidopa/levodopa 治療帕金森氏症患者 "off" 發作的附加治療。根據 BIAL 協議，本公司負責 ONGENTYS® 在美國的商業化與市場推廣，而 BIAL 負責製造與供應。本公司於 2024 年初開始分銷 ONGENTYS®。於 2025 年 12 月，本公司行使契約權利，通知 BIAL 欲於 2028 年 2 月 26 日終止授權協議，除非雙方同意延長。在終止生效前，本公司繼續依授權協議條款運作。

paragraphs: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (the "Company", "we," "us," or "our") 是一家多元化、全球性生物製藥公司，從事開發、製造、行銷與分銷多樣化的必要藥物。我們的 Affordable Medicines 分部包括零售用一般藥品、注射劑與生物相似藥。在我們的 Specialty 分部，我們提供專注於中樞神經系統與內分泌系統疾病的標的藥物組合。透過我們的 AvKARE 分部，我們是美國聯邦政府、零售與機構市場的藥物及其他產品經銷商。我們主要在美國、印度與愛爾蘭營運。請參閱下方 "Segments" 章節以瞭解我們的分部概要。

在 Reorganization（如本文所定義）之前，我們是一家控股公司，其主要資產為 Amneal Pharmaceuticals, LLC（"Amneal"）的普通單位（"Amneal Common Units"）。截至 2023 年 9 月 30 日，我們持有 50.4% 的 Amneal Common Units，而集團（與其關係企業及某些讓與人，這些讓與人為 Amneal 為私人公司時的所有者，稱為 "Amneal Group"）持有剩餘的 49.6%。2023 年 11 月 7 日，我們執行了一項計畫，根據該計畫，我們與 Amneal 重整並簡化我們的公司結構，消除我們的傘型合夥企業-C 股權公司結構，並轉為更傳統的結構，使所有股東直接透過上市公司持有其投票權與經濟權益（"Reorganization"）。自 Reorganization 生效後，我們持有 100% 的 Amneal Common Units，並合併 Amneal 及其子公司之財務報表。請參閱我們合併財務報表中的 Note 1. Nature of Operations 章節以取得更多關於 Reorganization 的資訊。
以下討論與分析包含涉及風險與不確定性的展望性陳述。我們的實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，原因在於某些因素，包括在 Item 1A. Risk Factors 以及本年度 10-K 報告中 Forward-Looking Statements 章節所列舉的那些因素。以下討論與分析，以及本報告中的其他章節，應與 herein 所附的合併財務報表及相關合併財務報表附註一併閱讀。

有關我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況與營運結果與 2023 年 12 月 31 日比較的討論，請參閱我們 2024 年年度報告 10-K 表單中 Part II, Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations 部分的 "Results of Operations" 與 "Liquidity and Capital Resources"。該年度報告於 2025 年 2 月 28 日提交給美國證券交易委員會。
我們有三個應報告分部：Affordable Medicines、Specialty 與 AvKARE。
我們的 Affordable Medicines 分部包括超過 280 種產品組合，涵蓋廣泛的劑型與給藥系統，包括即釋與延釋口服固體、粉末、液體、無菌注射劑、鼻噴劑、吸入與呼吸產品、生物相似藥、眼藥水、薄膜、經皮貼片與外用藥品。我們專注於開發具有重大進入門檻的產品，原因包括複雜的藥物配方或製造、或法律與法規上的挑戰。
一般藥品，特別是在美國，通常在其上市時對營收與毛利率有最顯著的貢獻，且在市場獨佔期或有限的通用藥競爭期，貢獻更為顯著。因此，新產品上市的時間點會對我們的財務結果產生重大影響。市場上新增的競爭通常會對相關產品的銷量與/或價格產生負面影響。此外，價格由市場動態決定，並常受我們無法控制的因素影響。

我們的 Specialty 分部從事開發、推廣、銷售與分銷專屬品牌的藥物產品，專注於治療中樞神經系統疾病，包括帕金森氏症，以及內分泌系統疾病。我們 Specialty 分部的重要產品包括 CREXONT®（carbidopa 與 levodopa 延釋膠囊組合）、RYTARY®（carbidopa-levodopa 延釋口服膠囊製劑）、UNITHROID®（levothyroxine sodium）與 Brekiya®（dihydroergotamine mesylate）注射劑。2024 年 9 月，我們開始銷售 CREXONT®，該藥物用於治療帕金森氏症、由腦部感染或發炎引起的帕金森氏症，或可能因一氧化碳或錳而產生的帕金森氏症樣症狀
成人中毒。RYTARY® 用於治療帕金森氏症、腦炎後帕金森症，以及可能因一氧化碳中毒或錳中毒後所引起的帕金森症。UNITHROID® 用於治療甲狀腺機能減退症，係透過與Jerome Stevens Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 簽訂的授權與分銷協議銷售。
新產品上市是重要的成長動力。Brekiya® 自動注射器，於2025年5月獲美國食品藥物管理局核准，並於2025年10月在美國上市，為首個且唯一可用的二氫麥角胺甲磺酸鹽自動注射器製劑，用於成人急性偏頭痛（含或不含視覺症狀）及急性羣集性頭痛的治療。
我們的專利產品透過具專業能力的專精銷售與行銷團隊進行推廣，這些團隊會拜訪美國的神經學家、動作障礙專科醫師、內分泌科醫師及一般內科醫師。我們的專精產品部門也擁有其他處於不同開發階段的產品候選藥物。
對於專精產品而言，這些產品的商業價值通常在產品擁有市場獨佔權的期間內實現。在美國，當市場獨佔權到期且產品的仿製藥獲得核准並上市銷售時，品牌藥的銷售通常會有顯著且快速的下降。2025年，RYTARY® 的經核准仿製藥已上市，本公司預期未來將有數種RYTARY® 的仿製藥上市。
2025年，CREXONT® 在我們的專精產品部門持續成長。CREXONT® 被納入三個大型國家型給付清單，使美國的保險給付覆蓋率從2024年底約30%的被保險人，增加至2025年底超過50%。2025年12月，我們宣佈了持續進行的第四期ELEVATE-PD研究的正面臨時結果，包括每日「良好狀態」時間顯著增加及「非良好狀態」時間減少。
我們的AvKARE部門主要向政府機構提供藥物，主要集中於服務美國國防部及美國退伍軍人事務部。AvKARE 也以 AvKARE 和 AvPAK 的註冊名稱重新包裝瓶裝及單劑藥物和維生素。AvKARE 也向其位於美國各地的零售與機構客戶，作為藥物、非處方藥及醫療用品的批發經銷商，這些客戶主要服務低收入及無保險的患者。AvKARE 銷售 Amneal 產品的營運結果包含在我們的可負擔藥物應報告分部中。

headings: 若我們無法成功開發或商業化新產品，將會影響我們的營運成果。
我們在製藥產業面臨來自品牌藥與仿製藥公司的激烈競爭，這可能會顯著限制我們的成長，並對我們的財務結果造成重大不利影響。
若我們無法取得產品的獨家行銷權，或未能及時將產品推向市場，我們的營收、毛利率與營運成果可能會顯著下降。
隨著我們的競爭對手推出其 own 的仿製藥產品，我們從這些產品所獲得的營收與毛利率通常會下降，有時甚至迅速下降。
我們的業務高度依賴市場對我們與我們產品安全與品質的觀感。
我們總營收的相當大一部分預期將來自少數幾種產品的銷售。
我們已核准的產品可能無法達到預期的市場接受度。
本公司可能停止製造及銷售某些現有產品，可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
製造或品質控制問題可能損害本公司在品質生產方面的聲譽，導致需進行昂貴的補救措施，並對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成負面影響。
本公司獲利能力取決於主要客戶。若這些關係未如預期持續，可能對本公司業務狀況（財務及其他方面）、前景及營運結果造成重大影響。
客戶集中化可能導致銷售量下降及產品價格下跌，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成重大負面影響。
供應鏈中斷可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成重大負面影響。
貿易政策的變更，包括課徵關稅，可能影響本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況。
美國政府停擺可能對本公司監管、營運及財務表現造成不利影響。
開發仿製藥所需時間可能影響本公司是否及在多大程度上獲得資本回報。
若本公司無法執行收購或其它戰略交易，或成功整合該等收購或管理由此產生的成長，將可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司依賴資訊科技，且本公司系統與基礎建設面臨某些風險，包括網路安全及資料外洩風險。
若無法成功實施新企業資源規劃系統，將可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
基於人工智慧的平台可能對本公司業務帶來新的風險與挑戰。
重大事件，包括嚴重天氣事件、戰爭及恐怖攻擊，可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。在決定是否投資本公司普通股時，應謹慎考慮下列風險因素，以及本年度報告表 10-K 所包含的其他資訊。這些風險因素實現後，可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
開發與商業化新產品耗時、耗費昂貴，且面臨許多障礙。本公司未來的營運成果取決於本公司能否成功且及時地商業化新產品。主要挑戰包括：
•在符合監管要求的前提下，以及時且成本效益的方式開發產品，並因美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）審查、列名及核准程序所導致的延誤，任何有關FDA程序的政策、監管或其他變更，以及本公司能否在合理時間內或完全取得所需監管核准，並在取得後維持這些核准；
•確保新產品或生物類似藥物與參考藥物具有安全性與有效性，或生物等效性的臨牀測試過程的成功；
•本公司之仿製藥產品可能被品牌藥產品競爭對手提起法律行動，包括專利侵權聲請等其他聲請；
•以商業合理條件取得原物料，包括活性藥物成分（API）及其他開發本公司藥物產品所必需的關鍵原料；
